text:
maria_cs: hey team, Acme on Net30 just flagged an invoice that is missing their PO number on the PDF. portal shows the PO correctly but the downloadable invoice PDF doesn't list it. invoice id INV-2026-00987. customer is asking for a reissued invoice with PO included, and they may need it for their AP cutoff tomorrow.

sam_support: thanks for flagging. quick check — is the PO on the invoice record in billing? can someone confirm the api output?

alex_billing: i pulled the invoice via the internal invoices API, the record has po_number set. snippet: ```json
{"invoice_id":"INV-2026-00987","po_number":"PO-98765","status":"issued","amount":"12500.00","currency":"USD"}
```

alex_billing: so it's present in the DB, looks like this is a rendering issue when we generate the PDF.

raj_eng: I can take a look at the PDF service. yesterday we deployed a template tweak for VAT lines — possible the template variable was removed by accident. i'll grep the last template commit.

devops_bot: deploy 2026-06-12T18:03Z - frontend-billing v3.4.7 -> successful (chg: invoice template update, #PR-412)

raj_eng: confirmed. template PR-412 changed invoice_footer partial and removed {{invoice.po_number}} in a refactor. i'm opening a revert/patch.

lisa_finance: for the customer: if invoice hasn't been paid yet we can reissue (void old + issue new with same due date). if paid, we need credit + rebill and coordinate refunds with AR. alex, can you check payment status?

alex_billing: payment_status: pending (no capture). so we can do a straight reissue.

maria_cs: great — they'll need the corrected PDF by EOD. can we do a manual reissue now? also include a short note on the invoice PDF header: "PO: PO-98765" so their AP recognizes it.

raj_eng: plan: push hotfix to restore PO variable, regenerate PDF and call reissue endpoint. ETA 1h if no surprises. i'll coordinate with alex for the reissue call.

alex_billing: reissue endpoint (internal): ```bash
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/api/v1/billing/reissue" -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-2026-00987","reason":"add_po_to_pdf","regenerate_pdf":true}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN"
```

sam_support: for audit, please add a short support note to the invoice thread: "reissued to include PO-98765 at customer request". i'll notify Acme once the new PDF is ready.

raj_eng: hotfix merged to release branch (PR-421). deploying now to billing-pdf-svc. monitor logs.

devops_bot: deploy 2026-06-12T18:47Z - billing-pdf-svc v2.1.9 -> successful

raj_eng: regenerate job started for INV-2026-00987. log tail: ```
[2026-06-12T18:48:10Z] regen started invoice=INV-2026-00987
[2026-06-12T18:48:12Z] template rendered, po_number=PO-98765
[2026-06-12T18:48:14Z] pdf stored s3://invoices/2026/INV-2026-00987.pdf
```

alex_billing: reissue call executed: response: {"status":"reissued","new_invoice_id":"INV-2026-00987-R1","pdf_url":"https://invoices.redwood/INV-2026-00987-R1.pdf"}

lisa_finance: added accounting note, updated ledger to mark original invoice voided and new invoice created, no payment changes required.

maria_cs: shared new PDF with Acme and confirmed receipt. they said looks good, thanks :thumbsup:. i asked them if they'd like a stamped copy and they declined.

sam_support: closing loop — next steps: (1) create a small regression test to ensure po_number appears in PDF templates (qa ticket), (2) add a lint check to template PRs to catch removed variables, (3) send a short postmortem to #eng-postmortems if scope > 1 customer.

raj_eng: noted. created ticket BILL-789 (qa) and TPL-143 (template lint).

maria_cs: thanks everyone. tagging for visibility @lisa_finance @alex_billing.

sam_support: marking thread resolved in support tracker. if Acme reports anything else we reopen.

lisa_finance: FYI — if this had been paid already we'd have triggered credit + rebill workflow: invoice void -> issue credit note CN-2026-00987 -> create new invoice INV-2026-00987-R1 and request capture, and record refund in AR. leaving notes here for runbook update.

maria_cs: adding runbook blurb now.

sam_support: thanks team, great quick turnaround.
